integrity: Proof based on a cited sharp upper bound, Kneser sumset theorem, Apéry minima, and Sylvester formula; finite verification is diagnostic rather than proof.
limitations: Equality cases of one bound only; no stability or improved off-equality bound. Full historical priority cannot be certified. The 1998 Frobenius article of Hamidoune was not available in full text during comparison.
title: Rigidity of equality in the sharp three-generator Frobenius bound
